scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,admin,desktop -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w admin-dashboard" "npm run dev -w desktop-app"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w admin-dashboard && npm run build -w desktop-app
scripts.build:production: npm run db:generate -w backend && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w admin-dashboard
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w desktop-app && npm run test -w admin-dashboard
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w desktop-app && npm run typecheck -w admin-dashboard
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build:production && npx vercel deploy --prod
